title: Indian PM Modi and Chinese FM Wang Yi open new chapter in bilateral relations ahead of SCO Summit
summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi met to enhance bilateral relations ahead of the Shanghai Cooperation Summit (SCO). Wang emphasized that India and China are "partners, not rivals." The meeting concluded Wang's visit to New Delhi for discussions with Indian National Security Advisor Ajit Doval, focusing on resolving the longstanding border dispute. The agreement aims to restore stability and trust after a military standoff and border clash in 2020. Both sides agreed to maintain peace in border areas through consultations

title: President Xi arrives in Lhasa, meets with representatives from across Xizang
summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping visited Lhasa and met with representatives from various ethnic groups and sectors in the Xizang Autonomous Region. He emphasized the importance of collaborative efforts to advance Chinese modernization in the region. Xi, who is also the general secretary of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and chairman of the Central Military Commission, conveyed greetings and best wishes on behalf of the CPC Central Committee to the people of Xizang. His visit coincided with the 60th anniversary of the region's founding.

title: Two WWII 'rescue' films: one true, the other a whitewash
summary: On August 15, the anniversary of Japan's WWII surrender, two maritime rescue films were released with contrasting messages. "Dongji Rescue" recounts the true story of the 1942 Lisbon Maru tragedy, highlighting Chinese fishermen who risked their lives to save British POWs from Japanese cruelty. In contrast, "Yukikaze" portrays an invading fleet as heroes, effectively whitewashing history. These films reflect the ongoing contestation of historical narratives and influence how the past is remembered or rewritten
